continuousSampling.method: age of the newest attested block, sampled every 60s

directMeasurement.method: watch a specific fresh block until is_height_attested flips true; measured from the BLOCK TIMESTAMP

mechanism: The attestation frontier runs roughly 30-40 Sepolia blocks behind head and advances in batches of exactly 10 blocks, about every 2 minutes. Sepolia produces 10 blocks in 2 minutes, so attestation keeps pace but never closes the gap. ~33 blocks x 12s is a ~6.6 min structural floor, plus alignment to the next batch. This is the Attestcoin network's cadence, not something our implementation can shorten.
